about: FIFA's own "FIFA member since" date for the association of every game nation, as each one's page on inside.fifa.com gave it on 2026-11-09 (robots.txt allows /associations/; one request every 1.2 s). FIFA gives 1 January where it knows only the year. scripts/football-federations.test.mjs checks src/data/footballFederations.js against it. sha256 is the page as fetched (gzip), a record of what was read: the pages change with every visit.

364.association: Islamic Republic of Iran Football Federation

KOS.unread: The page served on 2026-11-09 held no association record (a 14 KB shell); src/data/footballFederations.js keeps the date read on 2026-11-08.
